categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and land registration particulars. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
